}}'''Yurian Stonebow''' was a [[False Dragon]] who was capable of [[channel]]ing.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Yurian Stonebow}} He was born in [[Fel Moreina]] - modern day [[Far Madding]].

== History ==
He rose to power and declared himself to be The Dragon in [[1301 AB]]. He was able to kill three [[Aes Sedai]] and capture another three single-handedly. He was caught and gentled in [[1308 AB]]. He presumably died shortly thereafter.
